# Asendify Notes

> Asendify Notes (https://notes.asendify.co) is a private, Notion-style workspace for notes, docs and projects, made by Asendify. It runs in any modern web browser.

## Key facts
- Pages inside pages, a block editor with slash commands (headings, bullet/numbered lists, to-dos, toggles, tables, quotes, code, callouts, images, PDFs), @page mentions with backlinks, page covers, fonts, full width and page lock.
- Databases with text, number, select, multi-select, status, checkbox, date, link, email and phone properties, plus relations, rollups and formulas. Six views (table, board, list, gallery, calendar, timeline), each with filters and sorts. Each row is also a full page.
- Up to 20 workspaces per account. 10 built-in templates; import Markdown and CSV files.
- Page history (restore versions from the last 30 days) and comments on pages.
- Full-text search (Ctrl/Cmd K), trash with 30-day restore, read-only public links and free view-only guests invited by email (up to 50), export everything as Markdown + CSV (zip) or JSON at any time.
- Sign-in with one-time email links (no passwords). Light and dark mode. Saves automatically; editing in two tabs never silently overwrites.
- Price: £1,450 a year = £1,000 + 45% service fee (£450), shown in full before paying. No free plan, no free trial. Card buyers can choose auto-renew (£1,450 on the same date each year, with emails 14 and 3 days before; turn it off any time in Settings); PayPal is one year at a time. After a year ends without renewal, editing stops but notes are kept and can be exported for 30 days.
- One owner per account (no team editing or real-time co-editing); 2 GB for images and PDFs; 1 GB for text and page history.
- Installable Windows, macOS and Android apps are on the roadmap and not available yet.
- Not affiliated with Notion.
- Policies (payments and refunds): https://www.asendify.co/policies/

## Every feature, by name
- Pages inside pages: nest pages as deep as you like and open any of them from the sidebar tree
- Move pages: move a page, with everything inside it, anywhere in the tree or to another workspace
- Favourites and recently edited: pin the pages you use most and jump back to what you just worked on
- Slash commands: type / to add any block
- Headings and toggle headings: section headings, also available as collapsible toggles
- Bullet, numbered and to-do lists: checklists you can tick off inside any page
- Toggle lists: hide detail under a line you can open and close
- Tables inside pages: simple editable tables right in the page
- Code blocks: with syntax highlighting
- Quotes, callouts and dividers: callouts take an emoji of your choice
- Images and PDFs: upload images (up to 3 MB each) and PDFs (up to 5 MB each)
- Drag to reorder: drag blocks up and down, nest and un-nest them
- @ page mentions: type @ to link to another page
- Backlinks: every page shows which pages link to it
- Page icons and covers: an emoji icon and a cover image for any page
- Page fonts, full width and page lock: default, serif or mono font; full-width layout; lock a page against accidental edits
- Databases: every row is also a full page
- 15 property types: text, number, select, multi-select, status, checkbox, date, URL, email, phone, relation, rollup, formula, created time and edited time
- Number formats: plain number, percent, GBP, USD, EUR or INR
- Six database views: table, board (kanban), list, gallery, calendar and timeline
- Filters, sorts and group by: set separately for each view
- Relations and rollups: link databases and roll up count, sum, average, min or max
- Formulas: calculated properties
- Linked databases: show a database inside another page
- 10 templates: second brain, task board, simple CRM, content calendar, meeting notes, goals (OKRs), habit tracker, journal, reading list and team wiki
- Import Markdown and CSV: a .md file becomes a page, a .csv file becomes a database
- Search everything (Ctrl K / Cmd K): find any page by title or text, across all your workspaces
- Up to 20 workspaces: keep work, clients and personal life apart and switch in one click
- Page history: restore any version from the last 30 days, name versions and compare them
- Comments: comment on pages and mark comments as resolved
- Duplicate pages: copy a page with everything inside it
- Read-only public link: anyone with the link can read the page and the pages inside it; turn it off any time
- View-only guests: invite up to 50 people by email to read a page, free
- Export everything: Markdown + CSV (zip) or JSON, at any time
- Trash with 30-day restore: deleted pages wait 30 days before they are gone for good
- Passwordless sign-in: a one-time sign-in link sent to your email
- Autosave and sync: every change saves itself and shows up on your other devices; editing in two tabs never silently overwrites
- Light and dark mode: follows your device setting
- Runs in any modern browser: Windows, macOS, Linux, Android and iPhone

## Who Asendify Notes is for
- Freelancers, founders and consultants who want one private place for notes, docs, tasks and client work.
- People who like the Notion way of working (pages, blocks, databases) and want it in a simpler, private workspace.
- Anyone who shares finished pages with clients or family as read-only links or view-only guests.
- People who want to keep work, clients and personal life in separate workspaces.

## Who it's not for
- Teams who need several people editing the same workspace: there is one owner per account, and guests can only read.
- Anyone looking for a free plan or a free trial: there isn't one.
- People who need installable desktop or mobile apps or offline use today: it runs in the browser, and apps are on the roadmap.
- Teams that need integrations or an API to connect other tools: Asendify Notes doesn't offer them.

Last updated: 20 October 2026
